methods.label: Combine adjacent coefficients
methods.explanation:
The lower indices are consecutive, so Pascal's identity combines the two coefficients. For integers \(1\le k\le n\), it states \(C(n,k-1)+C(n,k)=C(n+1,k)\). Taking \(n=5\) and \(k=2\) gives
\[
C(5,1)+C(5,2)=C(6,2)=\frac{6\cdot5}{2\cdot1}=15.
\]
Thus the value is \(15\).
